Name: (CP) Nova's Game Title
Author: Novaphene
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/7DxaSXe.png[/img]
When you open stardew valley, you'll see either a scenery of your granpa's farm or a green landscape. Click the picture frame to see Caroline's tea!

[img]https://imgur.com/EwJVIBf.png[/img]
1. Download requirements (see 'requirements' dropdown). Make sure you have SMAPI too.
2. ﻿Download unzip the mod 
3. Move the mod in StardewValley/Mods folder 
4. Play
